name: Magma Boulder · Cold
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and explodes in a 4-block radius on hit. 3 shards scatter around with the same effects on creatures they touch. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 4.5 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 15 blocks within 1.45 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Leaves a 3-block zone for 7.5 s that repeats these effects every second
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 13.5 s
• Slowness II for 10.5 s
• Cold 25: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
